slides.title: One knee sleeve.
slides.body: Never two. The other one is in a different gym, waiting just as patiently.

slides.title: The shaker bottle.
slides.body: Lid on since August. Nobody is brave enough to open it. Nobody ever will be.

slides.title: Forty hair ties.
slides.body: Collected from every rig, rower and collar. The owners left long ago.

slides.title: A single shoe.
slides.body: Someone drove home with one shoe. They have questions. So do we.

slides.title: The rope with your name on it.
slides.body: Taped handles, cut to your height. You said you'd grab it tomorrow. That was March.

slides.title: A hoodie nobody claims.
slides.body: It's been there so long it's basically gym merch now. Coach wears it on cold mornings.
